name: lumen
vibe: "LUMEN" vertical 9:16 pure-TYPOGRAPHY template built around LIGHT. Every scene is a different light treatment on type: a travelling spotlight, a neon sign flickering on, a light sweep flooding outlined words, a moving sun casting long shadows, rotating rays, gradient-lit letters, flash hooks and a converging beam CTA. Organic design system tokens throughout (cream/sand, terracotta + sage, Caprasimo). Mounted after animations-v2.jsx + tweaks-panel.jsx. Portrait-native 9:16 (10 authored beats, 36.8s as shipped), rendered from its own bundle — only the words and pictures change.
